medicalDocument.title: Medical Document Processing System
medicalDocument.description: Developed an internal platform to automate the validation and management of medical documents used in insurance operations. The solution significantly reduced manual tasks, improved operational efficiency, and optimized document processing times.
highlights: Participated in architecture and technical design decisions to ensure scalability and maintainability
Collaborated with cross-functional teams under Agile methodologies to deliver business-aligned solutions

travelManagement.title: Internal Travel Management System
travelManagement.description: Developed a centralized platform for managing corporate travel, including requests, approvals, and reporting. The system replaced manual processes based on emails and spreadsheets, improving traceability and operational efficiency.
highlights: Automated approval workflows and centralized corporate travel information
Improved traceability and operational efficiency by replacing fragmented manual processes

reportingGenerator.title: Dynamic Data Reporting Generator
reportingGenerator.description: Designed and developed a dynamic report generation tool that enables users with basic database knowledge to create customized reports from multiple tables and data sources, reducing dependency on database administrators for reporting tasks.
highlights: Created an intuitive interface for building queries and reports without external tools
Integrated with multiple databases registered within the platform
Reduced dependency on database administrators for reporting tasks, freeing them to focus on higher-value activities

incidentReporting.title: Incident Reporting Management System
incidentReporting.description: Designed and developed a centralized incident reporting platform that enabled store employees to report workplace incidents and product-related issues through a structured and traceable workflow. The system improved visibility into operational risks and facilitated faster resolution.
highlights: Developed user-friendly reporting workflows and forms to improve adoption and data accuracy
Implemented role-based access and incident tracking features to support different operational teams
Replaced fragmented reporting methods with a centralized solution, improving process standardization
